cohort_l_discrepancy_explanation.root_cause: In Loop 27 development, an initial pilot set of 19 documents (68 fields across DEV/CAL) was proposed. The final manifest research/loop27/dataset_manifest.json and benchmark research/loop27/results/benchmark_results.json expanded this to 45 documents (120 fields: 30 DEV, 30 CAL, 30 BLIND, 30 CHALL). Early text drafts retained the 19 doc / 68 field figures, while the remaining 52 fields (BLIND+CHALL) were temporarily reported under 'Historical'. The actual dataset has always been 45 documents and 120 fields.

loops_20_23_discrepancy_explanation.root_cause: Loop 23 benchmarked 52 documents containing 113 fields. When Cohorts I, J, K, and L were subsequently integrated into the unified 791-field multi-cohort benchmark in Loop 27, template-duplicate documents and non-critical fields from Loops 20-23 were deduplicated to isolate a canonical 20-document, 43-field frozen historical regression core, preventing early synthetic forms from disproportionately skewing aggregate precision.
